{{documentation subpage}}

Note that this template is fussy and likely to behave strangely if it's assumptions aren't met. 

Template assumes you want to display a raw, and are on a raw subpage of page that is itself a subpage of [[language SYM.txt]]. In otherwords, [[:Category:Symbol raw pages|a grandchild of language SYM.txt]]. And assumes subst will be used.

It looks for an ALL CAPS symbol and caps parts of the page title....

== Usage ==
<nowiki>{{subst:Langsym raw}}
</nowiki>

See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Substitution#The_safesubst:_modifier for details on subst

== Output ==

This outputs something like 

''<nowiki><noinclude>{{raw header|symbol|DOMESTIC}}</noinclude>{{raw|v50:language_SYM.txt|SYMBOL|DOMESTIC}}<noinclude>{{raw footer|symbol|DOMESTIC}}</noinclude></nowiki>''

or

''<nowiki>{{raw header|symbol|DARKNESS}}</noinclude>{{raw|v50:language_SYM.txt|SYMBOL|DARKNESS}}<noinclude>{{raw footer|symbol|DARKNESS}}</nowiki>''

=== Limitation ===

It won't output this:

<nowiki>{{raw header|text_set|CURSE}}</noinclude>{{raw|v50:text_curse.txt|TEXT_SET|CURSE}}<noinclude>{{raw footer|text_set|CURSE}}</nowiki>

or this:

<nowiki><noinclude>{{raw header}}</noinclude>{{raw|v50:text_book_instruction.txt|TEXT_SET|BOOK_INSTRUCTION}}<noinclude>{{raw footer}}</noinclude></nowiki>

== Notes==

It uses [[Template:Raw_header]] and [[Template:Raw]] among other tpls

snippet

<nowiki>{{uc:{{#titleparts: {{FULLPAGENAMEE}} | -1 | -2 }}}}</nowiki>
